articles.title: Lone Star Said to Weigh Options for Coffee-Machine Firm Evoca
articles.summary: Private equity firm Lone Star Funds is mulling its options for Evoca SpA, including a potential handover of the business to creditors or a sale of the debt-laden Italian coffee machine maker, people familiar with the matter said.

articles.title: Ethiopian Airlines Cancels Tigray Flights as Rebels Take Airport
articles.summary: Ethiopian Airlines has suspended flights to three destinations in Tigray, after reports that forces affiliated to the Tigray People’s Liberation Front had taken control of the airport in the regional capital.

articles.title: Chinese AI Stocks Fall on Report of DeepSeek, Moonshot Probe
articles.summary: Shares of Chinese AI model developers fell after a report that the country’s regulators have opened a probe into startups DeepSeek and Moonshot AI over data security concerns.

articles.title: Ghana International Bank Eyes US Market as Africa Appetite Grows
articles.summary: London-based Ghana International Bank Plc wants to expand its presence to the US as American appetite grows for projects across Africa, new chief executive officer Ian Greenstreet said.

articles.title: Euro Hits Two-Month Low as Options Traders Add Downside Hedges
